reason: Leftover items from the Codex and Claude harness audits, each confirmed first. (1) Codex server requests that arrived between turns were dropped with the replayed notifications when the next run_turn started, so Codex waited for a reply forever; they are now declined before turn/start (-32000 for approval/input/elicitation requests as the Codex TUI declines them, -32601 for methods Nebula does not implement), skipping ones Codex already resolved, with a 'Codex request declined' notice. (2) Codex aborts a thread's pending requests when a turn completes, is interrupted or replaced and then sends serverRequest/resolved (bespoke_event_handling.rs abort_pending_server_requests + resolve_server_request_on_thread_listener); run_turn never read it while waiting for the operator, so the card stayed pending and the turn hung. The wait (_await_operator) now watches the stream, keeps other frames in order, and on a withdrawal yields a withdrawn approval/interaction event that the runtime turns into an EXPIRED approval (tool call CANCELLED) or EXPIRED interaction, sending Codex nothing. (3) cancel_turn and the cancelled stream_turn both sent turn/interrupt; the second, after TurnAborted, got 'no active turn to interrupt' (turn_processor.rs) and the HarnessProviderError replaced the CancelledError. An interrupted turn is not interrupted again and that invalid-request reply counts as a finished stop, as the Codex Python SDK treats it. (4) Usage after model/rerouted was priced with the requested model; each increment is now priced with the serving model and model_usage lists each priced model. (5) Claude steer(): verified against the bundled CLI of SDK 0.2.118 (2.1.209) with a mock Messages API that guidance sent after the last tool call is queued and answered in its own CLI turn after the steered turn's ResultMessage, which was then read as the next prompt's answer and survived a Stop. The adapter now passes --replay-user-messages; guidance the CLI has not echoed by the result keeps the Nebula turn open for the follow-up turn (answers joined, tokens summed) and a stop interrupts that turn too. Codex late goal updates were checked and are not a defect (the goal extension emits them in on_turn_stop before TurnComplete and the thread listener drains them first). tests/v3/test_harness_leftovers.py (16 tests; 14 fail on origin/main, the 2 guards pass before and after) proves each fix; the other node ids are the existing tests of the changed Codex wait, interrupt, usage and between-turn paths and the Claude steer/drain paths.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through harnesses.py) does not run a Codex app-server or Claude CLI with withdrawn requests, reroutes or steering; the Python tests drive the connections and runtime directly. test_harness_adapters.py, test_harnesses.py, test_claude_harness_turns.py, test_codex_transport.py, test_codex_turn_outcomes.py, test_harness_commands.py, test_harness_connection_state.py, test_harness_provider_subagents.py, test_harness_stopped_turns.py, test_grok_acp_compliance.py, test_approval_continuation.py, test_approval_handoff.py and test_vendor_session_recreate.py were run locally in full and pass but are not selected beyond the node ids listed. No full suites.
